scope: Future-only planning provenance; no change authorized for the current round.

activity.performed: Read-only official documentation and source inspection.

decision: Do not implement counting or a v8 transport this round. Keep v7 unchanged. Accurate admission counts alone cannot establish that a complete matched heavy workflow fits a remaining budget.

official_sources.supports: POST /v1/responses/input_tokens request schema and response.input_tokens integer response.
Model-specific input counting, including instructions, tools and multimodal input.
Model context and pricing assumptions, including the long-input threshold; reverify before future implementation.
The parent coordinator independently verified the free-counting and inference-quota statement here; this author did not independently reverify billing behavior or make an API call.

source_findings.gateway: The archived gateway prepare function computes a conservative text-byte/image bound before financial admission. v7 reuses the existing transport and budget history.
source_findings.witness: OwnedArm.enter independently checks its own byte-based reservation before forwarding. A gateway-only change would leave that earlier block in place.

future_minimal_design.mode: Explicit opt-in in a separately source-pinned transport and matching witness hook; no model, reasoning, context, tool, image or output-quality reduction.
future_minimal_design.normalization: Run original request validation and normalization first. Retain immutable generation-wire bytes and their SHA-256. Construct an explicitly reviewed count-schema projection and retain its separate SHA-256.
future_minimal_design.schema_projection: The documented count schema accepts conversation, input, instructions, model, parallel_tool_calls, personality, previous_response_id, reasoning, text, tool_choice, tools and truncation. Existing gateway restrictions remain authoritative. Omit only reviewed non-input transport, return, billing and cache-routing fields; unknown or unsupported fields require conservative handling rather than silent stripping.
future_minimal_design.quote: An authenticated local quote endpoint may use the existing key holder. Bind the result to exact normalized generation-wire SHA-256, model, counting projection and current open batch. Do not expose the provider key to the witness or model.
future_minimal_design.witness_binding: Before the existing affordability check, require exact quote/request identity, validate the count and reservation, then recheck cancellation, deadline and current headroom. Forward the identical normalized generation request. Authoritative financial admission remains in the budget gateway.

reservation.basis: Preserve the highest admitted 30-minute-cache/long-context input rate and long-context output rate. Current policy blocks 12-hour cache writes. Reverify rates, cache policy and service tier before use.
reservation.illustrative_only: At 180000 input tokens, this formula reserves $1.38. This is neither a measured workflow cost nor a completion guarantee.

failure_rules: Unavailable endpoint, timeout, unsupported schema, malformed object, non-integer count, invalid count or request-hash mismatch must not justify a smaller reservation; use the original conservative bound where it is still valid or reject.

A valid count exceeding the old input bound demonstrates that the old bound is insufficient. Use the larger counted bound, a valid full-context bound, or reject. Never fall back to the demonstrated insufficient old bound.
A count beyond the admitted context, unknown pricing/cache policy, or an unaffordable valid bound must reject admission.
A quote/forward mismatch must not forward using the cheaper quote. Keep quote evidence and the actual admitted request bound consistent.
Any later count-versus-generation usage discrepancy must preserve actual usage and financial evidence, halt or review future admissions, and never create a refund or synthetic settlement.
future_minimal_design.evidence: Durably retain non-secret count method, request/projection hashes, count, rates and reservation in a separate source-pinned evidence record. No raw requests, keys or invented provider receipts. Count-only calls do not consume inference-call allowance or create financial credits.

financial_continuity.rule: No new allowance, reset, refund, settlement fabrication or history rewrite.
financial_continuity.handoff: Only after quiescence and explicit review may a future process reacquire the same exclusive locks and append to the same budget journal. Preserve every existing receipt and held liability; verify the entire existing prefix, including all 579 current receipts reported by the parent at this planning point.
financial_continuity.source_integrity: Keep original v7 and imported source bytes and their anchor unchanged. A future transport needs an additional reviewed source/handoff binding; the old anchor does not authenticate new code.

qualification_required_before_any_future: Pure and fake-HTTP tests for schema projection, immutable wire/hash binding, count anomalies, timeout/fallback, valid counts above the old bound, tools and inline images, full output reservation, tier/cache policy, batch binding and concurrent budget admission.
Read-only replay proving all prior known receipts, both unknown holds, limits and restart locks remain intact, with no new grant or empty-journal reset.
Separately authorized free-count-only checks for the admitted model and representative supported payloads before considering inference admission.
Apply the same counting mode to both arms and disclose the instrumentation change. Actual usage pricing and quality gates remain unchanged.
scope_estimate: Approximately 200-350 runtime lines plus focused tests; an estimate, not an implementation or qualification result.
interpretation: This proposal improves reservation accuracy. It does not itself reduce provider charges, demonstrate Vector savings, prove a matched workflow will finish, or establish an efficiency claim.
